facts.note: States the kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast, kept so on purpose so nothing is late.
Lina came down to the kitchen at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Piano began at two minutes to eleven and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.

added.quote: When it was time for the toast, I went up the stairs to fetch the master.
added.why: Rosa left the kitchen and went up to the atelier at toast time, a moment the fact sheet does not cover. It also places her departure after the events on the sheet, so her whereabouts from then on are no longer the kitchen's.
